Eggertsville Cape Cod — Beautifully Updated & Move-In Ready!
Welcome to this adorable 4-bedroom, 2-full-bath Cape Cod in the heart of Eggertsville, thoughtfully updated and lovingly maintained with a wonderful blend of classic charm and modern convenience. Major improvements over the years make this home truly move-in ready!

Inside, you'll find refinished original wood flooring throughout the first-floor living room, bedrooms and stairs, complemented by new vinyl flooring in the kitchen, hallways and bathroom. The renovated kitchen features custom cabinetry and all-new stainless-steel appliances. Beautiful crown molding adds an elegant finishing touch to the first-floor living room, kitchen and bathroom.

The second-floor bedrooms feature new carpeting, while one bedroom has been thoughtfully plumbed for a potential future bathroom addition. 

Four-season enjoyment awaits with your own hot tub—perfect for soaking beneath summer stars or enjoying a warm, relaxing retreat on a snowy winter evening. There is also a renovated front porch with vinyl railings,  a side door portico, plus leaf filters installed on all gutters. The solar installation means enjoying significantly reduced electric bills. 

With its charming Cape Cod character, extensive list of updates, energy-saving solar panels, inviting outdoor spaces and desirable Eggertsville location, this home offers a wonderful opportunity to simply move in and enjoy!

Updates include: Roof (2019) | Vinyl Windows (2020) | HVAC & Hot Water Tank (2021) | Solar Panels (2021) | Air Purifier & Duct Cleaning (2023) | Bathroom Renovation (2023) | Water Purification System (2023) | Hot Tub (2023) | Plus flooring, kitchen, porch and additional improvements.
